newsitem.title: CANADA: Bombardier sees 67 orders etc for new jet.
newsitem.headline: Bombardier sees 67 orders etc for new jet.

text.p: Bombardier Inc said on Wednesday it has 67 orders, options and memoranda of understanding from seven airlines on four continents for its new 70-seat Canadair Regional Jet, Series 700.
Bombardier said at a media conference that the lead customer for the new jet, which is a stretched version of its 50-seat regional jet, is Brit Air of Morlaix, France, with four orders.
The stretched Regional Jet program was officially launched on January 21.

Robert Brown, president of Bombardier Aerospace said: "The launch of the Canadair Regional Jet Series 700 program reflects our long term commitment to the regional aircraft industry. Regional airlines will increasingly require genuine families of aircraft. Our significant investments in both the de Havilland Dash 8 Series 400 and CRJ Series 700 programs is testimony to our determination to remain the manufacturer of choice by regional airlines worldwide."
